title: Nerve Tissue Processing for Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM)
author: Natalia Biscola
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xpxfmpn
materials: Dehydrate tissues with alcohol solutions in different concentrations, as follow: 30%, 50%, 70, 80, 95, and 100% (twice) solution diluted in ddH 2 O 00:10:00, each Use 200 Proof Alcohol to prepare the solutions.

steps.title: Perform Transcardial Perfusion
steps.instruction: Perfuse animals transcardially with 0.12M Millonigs buffer (MB), pH=7.3, followed by 2% paraformaldehyde and 1.25% glutaraldehyde diluted in MB for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Post-fix and Rinse Tissues
steps.instruction: Post-fix dissected tissues of interest and rinse them to remove excess fixative.

substeps.instruction: Post-fix tissues in the same fixative overnight at 4°C
Rinse tissues 3 times with PBS for 30 minutes each
Wash tissues 3 times with ddH2O for 10 minutes each

steps.title: Fix with Osmium Solution
steps.instruction: Fix tissues using 1% Osmium solution diluted in ddH2O for 1 hour in a circular shaker.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Osmium solution at least one day in advance
Perform work in a fume hood using appropriate PPE due to toxicity

steps.title: Dehydrate Tissues
steps.instruction: Dehydrate the tissues using 100% propylene oxide for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Infiltrate and Embed Tissues
steps.instruction: Infiltrate tissues with Epon resin and embed them in plastic molds.

substeps.instruction: Place tissues in 50% propylene oxide and 50% Epon solution for 2 hours
Place tissues in 100% Epon resin overnight
Block tissue of interest in plastic molds, oriented for future cross-sectioning
Prepare 100mL Epon (Eponate 12 Kit, DMP-30 Ted Pella #18010) by mixing 47.6mL RESIN, 32.0mL DDSA, 23.0mL NMA, and 1.6mL DMP-30

steps.title: Section and Stain Tissues
steps.instruction: Cut semi-thin sections and stain them for visualization.

substeps.instruction: Cut 0.5μm semi-thin cross sections and place on glass slides
Label sections with 1% toluidine blue solution diluted in ddH2O for 30 seconds
Wash sections with ddH2O, dry, and coverslip with DPX medium

steps.title: Acquire and Analyze Images
steps.instruction: Use a Nikon Eclipse E600 microscope and Nikon camera DS-Fi3 to capture images.
